name: Between Love & Uprising: A Cheaters Dating Simulator
source:
A Brazilian dating sim that takes place in the Minas Gerais Conspiracy, an unsuccessful separatist movement in Colonial Brazil in 1789.

Inspired by real historical figures, this game lets you romance five rebels who dreamed of freeing Minas Gerais, a Brazilian state, from Portuguese rule. In a world of poetry, secrets, betrayal, and revolution, your choices shape the outcome, both in love and in history.

Play as a protagonist of any gender and navigate complex relationships during one of the most fascinating, yet overlooked, chapters of Latin American history.

Will you change the course of the conspiracy or simply fall in love along the way?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4029590/Between_Love__Uprising_A_Cheaters_Dating_Simulator/]Steam[/url]]
